fields.name: DefectDojo
fields.description: Vulnerability management platform where Rekono will import findings when synchronization is enabled at project level

fields.name: NVD NIST
fields.description: National Vulnerability Database from where Rekono will get CVE information to aggregate findings information

fields.name: HackTricks
fields.description: Wiki that includes extensive documentation about hacking techniques and tricks, and whose resources will be linked by Rekono

fields.name: CVE Crowd
fields.description: Platform that identifies the most trending CVEs at the moment based on their impact on social networks, and whose data will be used by Rekono to check if the CVEs detected are trending or not

fields.name: Virus Total
fields.description: Malware analysis platform that analyzes files, hosts or URLs, and whose reputation data will be used by Rekono to add context to the hosts identified

fields.name: GitHub Security Advisories
fields.description: GitHub Security Advisories from where Rekono will get CVE information to aggregate findings information

fields.name: EU Vulnerability Database
fields.description: European Union Vulnerability Database from where Rekono will get CVE information to aggregate findings information

fields.name: Open Source Vulnerabilities
fields.description: Open Source Vulnerabilities from where Rekono will get CVE information to aggregate findings information

fields.name: FIRST EPSS
fields.description: FIRST Exploit Prediction Scoring System from where Rekono will get EPSS scores and percentiles for detected CVEs
